title: Decoding Non-Neuronal Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targets in Huntington's Disease Through Integrative Transcriptomics and Machine Learning.
authors: Gupta, Himanshi; Singh, Samvedna; Kaushik, Aman Chandra; Awasthi, Amit K; Sahi, Shakti
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习与转录组分析寻找亨廷顿病治疗靶点，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is a rare, inherited neurodegenerative disorder caused by the expanded CAG repeats in the huntingtin gene. The HD domain still lacks detailed knowledge of validated drug targets, limiting the effectiveness of classical methods. To address this gap, we have applied an integrated computational approach, combining machine learning (ML) with transcriptomic analysis, to identify novel therapeutic targets. Differential expression analysis was performed on eight publicly available datasets, comprising 209 healthy control and 193 Huntington's disease patient samples, followed by ML-based screening of differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Feature selection using mRMR and RFE, in combination with four classifiers (Linear SVC, Stochastic Gradient Descent, Logistic regression, and Ridge regression), yielded 138 DEG candidates. Subsequent literature curation, drug target analysis, and gene regulatory network (GRN) construction highlighted several key genes, including TXNIP, TNIP3, HTR1D, ADRB1, and FOXP1, which may play pivotal roles in disease progression. Furthermore, our findings highlight the contribution of non-neuronal mechanisms, such as endothelial dysfunction, vascular neurodegeneration, thermoregulation, metabolic imbalance, and impaired phagocytosis, providing a broader perspective into HD pathophysiology. This comprehensive strategy advances our HD knowledge regarding therapeutic targets, molecular pathways, transcription factors (TFs), and complex gene interactions beyond classical HD processes. In summary, the study successfully identifies a promising set of novel drug targets, indicating potential implications in HD therapy.
abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病（Huntington's disease, HD）是一种罕见的遗传性神经退行性疾病，由亨廷顿基因中扩增的CAG重复序列引起。HD领域仍缺乏对已验证药物靶点的详细知识，限制了经典方法的有效性。为弥补这一空白，我们采用了一种整合计算策略，将机器学习（machine learning, ML）与转录组分析相结合，以识别新型治疗靶点。对八个公开可用的数据集进行了差异表达分析，包括209个健康对照和193个亨廷顿病患者样本，随后基于ML对差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）进行筛选。使用mRMR和RFE进行特征选择，并结合四种分类器（线性支持向量分类器、随机梯度下降、逻辑回归和岭回归），共获得138个DEG候选基因。随后的文献筛选、药物靶点分析和基因调控网络（gene regulatory network, GRN）构建突出了几个关键基因，包括TXNIP、TNIP3、HTR1D、ADRB1和FOXP1，这些基因可能在疾病进展中发挥关键作用。此外，我们的发现强调了非神经元机制的贡献，如内皮功能障碍、血管神经退行性变、体温调节、代谢失衡和吞噬功能受损，为HD病理生理学提供了更广阔的视角。这一综合策略推进了我们对HD治疗靶点、分子通路、转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）及超越经典HD过程的复杂基因相互作用的认识。总之，本研究成功识别了一组有前景的新型药物靶点，表明其在HD治疗中具有潜在意义。
